analysis.visual_description: The sun is gone. Iron cressets burn round the galleries. He stands behind the arras with the Prince's roll in his hand and the afternoon still in his ear: Pope's Nurse stopped the play three times; Phillips's Mercutio was laughed with and then, very suddenly, not; Kemp's fan is on the boards where he set it down after the lines that were written and one line more.

Romeo calls for light. It is brought, real fire into real dusk. A small figure lies on the trestle bier. Nick has come in under every note and held. In a house of two thousand not one nut is cracked. In the upper rooms women weep into their mufflers.
He goes on. The yard does not move while he shuts it. The line he speaks is the last of the book, and it is short.
The line is done. Nobody moves at first. The church hat is still in the lower gallery. He does not look to see what the face under it is doing.
